items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: Scovill(?) wanted me to come back with him and play with him

ctx.x: Let's move on here a bit. I know then you went with...

Right after that... Not long afterwards... Well, this was '56. I toured around, and I got a letter from Joe Glaser that Louis wanted to sign me up and go on the road. Scovill(?) wanted me to come back with him and play with him, and different... I got a lot of offers. But I stayed here, playing around in these different clubs and everything. Anyway, it goes on up to... They organized... Harvey Brooks and somebody from Disneyland come up and was talking about Young Men From New Orleans...oh, a band for that boat,…
